newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian state offers to sell industrial gas firm.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian state offers to sell industrial gas firm.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Holding Company for Chemical Industries said on Monday it wanted to auction 90 percent of subsidiary Industrial Gases Company as part of the government's privatisation programme.
The remaining 10 percent of the company will be offered to employees of the company, it said.
Tender documents will be available until October 15 and the deadline for bids is November 30, a company official said.
The holding company said Industrial Gases Company was the leading producer of industrial gases in Egypt and an important producer of rutile welding electrodes.
It owns and operates production sites, filling stations, sales offices and its own fleet of trucks for distributing liquid product.
The company had a turnover of 42.5 million pounds in the financial year 1995/6, which ended on June 30, and it is profitable, the holding company added.
"The company is operating in a market which promises attractive growth opportunities," it added.
